load_json_from_file: use JsonHandler to load JSON data from a file object into a Python dictionary
dump_json_to_file: use JsonHandler to dump a Python object to a JSON file with numpy array support
dump_json_to_string: use JsonHandler to serialize a Python object to a JSON string with custom default handler
serialize_numpy_for_json: use set_default to convert numpy arrays and generics to JSON-serializable Python types
handle_non_serializable_types: use set_default to convert sets, ranges, and numpy types to lists for JSON dumping
